acceptanceCriteria: A sweep command or closeout step prunes worktree registrations whose directories are gone and removes scratch of sessions/lanes closed for more than 24 h.

Repos with uncommitted or unpushed work are archived (bundle + patch + status) before removal, never silently deleted; active lanes and owner-approved toolchain dirs are excluded by an explicit keep list.
The sweep reports before/after free disk and counts; closeout-seal or the lane charter runs it after each batch merge.
Related to V1-1632 (per-lane removal) and V1-0360 (go-build trim).
body: Measured 2026-10-19: the primary repo had 228 registered worktrees (30 after git worktree prune); a closed session's scratchpad (b89960c8, last write Oct 11) held 69 GB; /private/tmp/cem10-build held 173 merged/pushed clones (~25 GB) and ~49 GB of non-git lane scratch older than 24 h. A one-off sweep (dirty/unpushed repos archived as bundle+patch first, toolchains kept) raised free disk from 105 GiB to 217 GiB and trimmed go-build to 23 GB. Nothing does this automatically. V1-1632 covers removing a lane's checkout after its PR merges; this ticket covers the sweep that catches everything else: closed sessions' scratch, orphaned worktree registrations, and lane scratch whose lane is gone.
title: Orchestrator and lanes never reclaim closed-session scratch or stale registered worktrees
